meta.value: result is null if divisor b is zero to avoid division by zero

invariants.rationale: If the method does not throw and returns normally, result is non-null (since b != 0).

meta.value: result is only non-null if division occurs

invariants.rationale: When a is an Integer, the result is also an Integer.

meta.value: result type matches input type when a is Integer

invariants.rationale: When a is a Double, the result is also a Double.

meta.value: result type matches input type when a is Double
